## Summary

```{r}
summary
```

## Reporting Checklist

- Motivating research question.
- Prior evidence or theory motivating the selected conditions.
- Manipulated conditions and rationale for levels.
- Data-generating model and population values.
- Fitted model and software details.
- Performance metrics and interpretation standards.
- Tables or figures for the most relevant patterns.
- Conclusions tied back to the research question.
